purpose: Candidate indicator definitions for Financial Inclusion & Poverty Reduction; no entries are currently approved for calculation or publication.
global_limitations: No codebook with verified variable semantics is currently available in the project.
Local source authorization and licensing remain unverified.
No indicator in this catalogue should be calculated from the local microdata until evidence and domain review are complete.
Separate surveys must not be linked at household level without documented authorization and compatible linkage identifiers.

indicators.description: Candidate concept for access to a formal financial service; not an implemented or verified estimate.
indicators.policy_question: Which population groups face limited access to formal financial services?
indicators.missing_value_treatment: To be defined from an authorized codebook and questionnaire review.
indicators.survey_weight_requirements: A dataset-specific survey weight must be identified and reviewed before estimation.
indicators.calculation_method: Blocked until numerator, denominator, variable coding, and survey design are verified.
interpretation_cautions: Do not infer formal access from a variable name alone.
Do not compare surveys without a documented harmonization method.

indicators.description: Candidate concept for use of savings products or mechanisms; not an implemented or verified estimate.
indicators.policy_question: What barriers or differences exist in the use of savings services?
indicators.missing_value_treatment: Blocked pending verified response categories and nonresponse rules.
indicators.survey_weight_requirements: Use only a weight documented for this dataset and population.
indicators.calculation_method: Blocked until source variables and denominator population are verified.
interpretation_cautions: Savings product use and account ownership are not interchangeable concepts.

indicators.description: Candidate concept for use of formal or informal credit; not an implemented or verified estimate.
indicators.policy_question: Which groups report limited access to or use of credit services?
indicators.missing_value_treatment: Blocked pending verified response categories and eligibility rules.
indicators.survey_weight_requirements: Use only a weight documented for this dataset and population.
indicators.calculation_method: Blocked until source variables, denominator, and design metadata are verified.
interpretation_cautions: Formal and informal credit must not be collapsed without documented justification.

indicators.description: Candidate concept for use of digital financial services; not an implemented or verified estimate.
indicators.policy_question: How does digital financial-service use vary across approved population groups?
indicators.missing_value_treatment: Blocked pending verified response categories and missing-data rules.
indicators.survey_weight_requirements: Use only a weight documented for this dataset and population.
indicators.calculation_method: Blocked until the digital-service variables and denominator are verified.
interpretation_cautions: Mobile-money use, internet access, and digital financial-service use are distinct concepts until documented otherwise.

indicators.description: Candidate concept for reported barriers to financial-service access; not an implemented or verified estimate.
indicators.policy_question: What reasons are reported for not using or accessing financial services?
indicators.missing_value_treatment: Blocked pending verified multiple-response and nonresponse handling.
indicators.survey_weight_requirements: Use only a weight documented for the relevant respondent population.
indicators.calculation_method: Blocked until questionnaire structure and response coding are verified.
interpretation_cautions: Multiple-response questions require an explicit denominator and aggregation rule.

indicators.description: Placeholder for an authorized poverty measure whose official definition and source variables are verified; no measure is selected in Phase 4.
indicators.policy_question: How can an authorized poverty measure support poverty-reduction decisions?
indicators.unit: to be defined from official documentation
indicators.missing_value_treatment: To be defined from the official measure and source methodology.
indicators.survey_weight_requirements: Dataset-specific design and weights must be verified before any estimate.
indicators.calculation_method: Blocked; no official variable mapping or authorization decision is recorded.
interpretation_cautions: Do not infer a poverty line, poverty status, or district estimate from filenames or variable names.

indicators.description: Candidate framework for comparing approved estimates across valid geographic units; not a district statistic.
indicators.policy_question: Which geographic comparisons are valid and useful for approved indicators?

source_documentation.status: boundary files present; licensing and vintage review outstanding

indicators.missing_value_treatment: To be defined after valid geographic identifiers and sample design are verified.
indicators.survey_weight_requirements: Geographic comparisons require dataset-specific survey design review.
indicators.calculation_method: Blocked; boundary presence does not establish that survey estimates support district-level comparison.
interpretation_cautions: Do not infer district-level statistics from boundary files alone.
Do not link surveys by similar geography or schema without authorization.
